newsitem.title: USA: Alex. Brown names institutional muni sales manager.
newsitem.headline: Alex. Brown names institutional muni sales manager.

text.p: Alex. Brown & Sons has tapped former Greenwich Partners Inc vice president John Wasilewski as its new institutional municipal sales manager, an Alex. Brown official said Thursday.

The hiring of Wasilewski, who started Thursday in Baltimore, continues Alex. Brown's drive to build it's secondary institutional business under a plan set in motion last August with the hiring of former head Prudential muni trader Gerard McNamara, according to C. Randall Coleman, manager of Alex. Brown's municipal department.

"This is an effort to try to engage in a deeper penetration of the institutional secondary market where we see real opportunity for Alex. Brown to have a much more significant presence," Coleman said. "The catalyst here is our commitment to the business as demonstrated by the hiring of Gerry McNamara."

Alex. Brown's strategy, as first outlined at the time of McNamara's hiring, continues to be "to selectively build around strong, relationship-oriented professionals that can bring existing relationships to the Alex. Brown franchise for a significant change in our penetration ability in the institutional market."

Though Alex. Brown is currently in talks with additional industry professionals, the firm will add staff carefully, Coleman said. While the it wants a bigger piece of the institutional secondary market, the firm realizes that industry volume remains light, he said.

"We have enjoyed the opportunity to speak with several really top-flight candidates, but we are going to proceed where opportunity tells us it is a great fit," Coleman said. "We are definitely not in just an all out campaign to add personnel for the sake of building up staff."
Coleman emphasized that Wasilewski, who previous to Greenwich Partners was employed by Glickenhaus & Co in New York, will be a producing sales manager.
"He will be a producing sales manager, which is a change for us," Coleman said. "He will cover accounts as well as doing the administrative role."
